title: Law to update pedicab meters, licenses and penalties
summary: This bill would require pedicabs to use meters instead of timers and registration plates with scannable codes showing the business name and registration number. It directs the Department of Consumer and Worker Protection to issue official signage, create a mandatory safety training course for drivers, and let drivers pick up licenses in person. It also removes jail time as a penalty for pedicab violations and bars drivers from using sound devices that create illegal noise.
